evidence.why: Distinguishes state index from animation ID.

facts.rationale: The baseline conflates the first member with a state ID. The generic state changer indexes the table by msid and separately reads anim_id; these numeric values happen to coincide in this table.
facts.value: A two-element ItemStateTable array. Array indices select item motion states 0 and 1; their first members select animation IDs 0 and 1 respectively. Both entries contain the bool(Item_GObj*) animation callback itGamewatchparachute_UnkMotion1_Anim and null physics and collision callbacks.

evidence.why: Canonical signature, attachment and nullable return.
Caller supplies fighter, position, part and facing.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact declaration and supported semantic parameter domains without asserting compiled opcode equivalence with another constructor.
facts.value: A nullable fighter-article constructor with canonical signature HSD_GObj*(Item_GObj* parent, Vec3* pos, enum_t part, float facing_dir). Its fighter-side caller supplies the owning fighter GObj, the TransN joint's world position, FtPart_TransN as the attachment identifier, and the fighter's facing direction. It returns the attached article on successful creation or NULL on failure.

evidence.why: Exact reference-clearing effects and Boolean result.

facts.rationale: The canonical callee provides useful operation and lifetime semantics beyond an unspecified helper delegation, while the event-trigger uncertainty remains intact.
facts.value: Adapts an item-system event to generic interaction-reference cleanup for the Parachute article. It forwards gobj and ref_gobj unchanged to it_8026B894 and discards its Boolean owner-match result. The helper clears matching owner, reflector, absorber, fighter and toucher references, resetting xCB0_source_ply to 6 when xCEC_fighterGObj is cleared. Clearing the owner can subsequently make the Parachute lifetime callback request removal. The wrapper does not establish an exclusive event trigger.
